€1, 10. P. (घण्टति, घण्टयति) 
__1 To speak. 
__2 To shine.

a. Shining, splendid 
-ण्टः 
__1 N. of Śiva. 
__2 A kind of sauce, a kind of dish. 
-Comp. 
-फलकः a shield with a ringing sound.

[घण्ट्-अच्] 
__1 A bell. 
__2 A plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a clock. 
-Comp. 
-अगारम् a belfry. 
-कर्णः 
__1 N. of a demigod under Śiva, (of Skanda or of Kuber) worshipped in the month of Chaitra (also -ईश्वरः). 
__2 a fabulous demon, Rākṣasa; [[

. 
-र्णी N. of a goddess. 
-फलकः, -कम् a shield furnished with small bells. 
-ताडः a bellman; नॄन्प्रशंसत्यजस्रं यो घण्टाताडोरुणोदये [[

.]] 
-नादः the sound of a bell. 
-पथः 
__1 the chief road through a village, a highway, main road; (दशधन्वन्तरो राजमार्गो घण्टापथः स्मृतः [[Kau. A.]]). 
__2 N. of Mallinātha's commentary on the Kirātārjunīyam; कर्तुं प्रवेशमिह भारविकाव्यमध्ये घण्टापथं कमपि नूतनमातनिष्ये [Page0684-2] [[Malli.]] 
-मुद्रा a particular way of intertwining fingers (before ringing a bell). 
-रवः 
__1 a species of hemp (Mar. तुरी, शणपुष्पिका, लघुताग इ.) 
__2 sound of a bell; घण्टारबः शणसुमे घण्टानादे च पुंसि वा [[Nm.]] 
-वाद्यम् the sound of a clock. 
-शब्दः 
__1 bell-metal. 
__2 the sound of a bell.

a. 
__1 Furnished with bells. 
__2 Sounding like a bell. -m. An epithet of Śiva.

__1 A string of bells tied on an elephant's chest by way of ornament. 
__2 Heat, light.
